title: Bridging the Semantic Chasm: Synergistic Conceptual Anchoring for Generalized Few-Shot and Zero-Shot OOD Perception
reasoning: The paper focuses on solving technical cross-modal alignment issues in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) for out-of-distribution perception. It contains no components related to evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
